Integrations.Title: Integrations
Integrations.Subtitle: Connect external services so agents can act on your tasks and repositories.
Integrations.Info: Integrations allow the voice agent to interact with external services. Configure Email to send messages, SMS for text messaging, and Todoist for task management. Without API keys, the corresponding agents will not be created to keep the system modular.
Integrations.Todoist.Subtitle: Task Management
Integrations.Todoist.Description: Connect to Todoist for task management capabilities. The Task Agent will be enabled when a valid API key is provided.
Integrations.WebSearch.Title: Web search
Integrations.WebSearch.Description: Lets the agent search the web. Create a search engine at programmablesearchengine.google.com, then a Custom Search JSON API key in Google Cloud. Changes apply to the next message.
Integrations.GitHub.Subtitle: Repository Access
Integrations.GitHub.Description: Connect GitHub so Kam can inspect repositories when coding tasks need repository context. Advanced GitHub App mode remains available for organization-scoped installations.
Integrations.GitHub.PrivateKeyHint: Use a PEM file path only; never paste raw private key material.
Integrations.GitHub.Detail.Idle: Connect GitHub with your local sign-in, or use Advanced GitHub App settings for organization-scoped access.
Integrations.GitHub.Detail.CheckingSignI: Checking local GitHub sign-in and repository access.
Integrations.GitHub.Detail.CheckingApp: Checking GitHub App credentials and repository access.
Integrations.GitHub.Detail.PemPathOnly: Enter the PEM file path only. Do not paste raw private key material into this field.
Integrations.GitHub.Detail.KeyDiscarded: Raw private key material was discarded. Enter the PEM file path only.
Integrations.GitHub.Detail.SettingsChang: GitHub App settings changed. Test connection again before listing repositories.
Integrations.GitHub.Detail.SettingsPrese: Settings are present. Test connection to verify repository access.
Integrations.GitHub.Detail.SettingsSaved: Settings saved. Test connection to verify repository access.
Integrations.GitHub.Detail.FactoryUnavai: GitHub App client factory is not available in this runtime.
Integrations.GitHub.Detail.AppConnectedL: GitHub App connected, but repository list failed: {0}
Integrations.GitHub.Detail.SignInReposit: {0} repositories visible through your GitHub sign-in.
Integrations.GitHub.Cli.NotSignedIn: GitHub CLI is not signed in. Run `gh auth login --web` once, then connect again.
Integrations.GitHub.Cli.ParseFailed: GitHub repository response could not be parsed: {0}
Integrations.GitHub.Cli.NotStarted: GitHub CLI could not be started.
Integrations.GitHub.Step.AppIdHelp: Copy the App ID from the GitHub App settings page.
Integrations.GitHub.Step.InstallationIdH: Install the app on selected repositories, then copy the installation ID.
Integrations.GitHub.Step.KeyPathHelp: Create a GitHub App private key, store the PEM outside the repository, then enter its file path.
Integrations.GitHub.Step.KeyPathInvalid: Enter a PEM file path only. Key contents are not displayed or saved by this screen.
Integrations.GitHub.Step.KeyPathReady: PEM file path is present and key material is not displayed.
Integrations.GitHub.Step.KeyPathMissing: PEM file was not found. Keep the key outside the repository and verify the path before testing.
Integrations.GitHub.Step.TestVerified: GitHub App credentials and repository access were verified.
Integrations.GitHub.Step.TestBlocked: Complete required fields, save, then run Test Connection.
Integrations.GitHub.Step.TestPending: Run Test Connection to verify credentials and selected repository access.
Integrations.Email.Title: Email (SMTP)
Integrations.Email.Subtitle: Email Communication
Integrations.Email.Description: Configure SMTP settings to enable email sending capabilities. The Communication Agent will be able to send emails on your behalf.
Integrations.Email.GmailTip: Tip: For Gmail, use an App Password instead of your regular password
Integrations.Sms.Subtitle: SMS Messaging
Integrations.Sms.Description: Connect to Twilio for SMS messaging capabilities. The Communication Agent will be able to send text messages.
